FAQ

Questions, answered.

Is DN Launcher free?

Yes. The launcher is completely free. You only need a Minecraft: Java Edition account.

Do I need to own Minecraft?

Yes. You sign in with the Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. The launcher never sees your password; login happens on Microsoft's own page.

Why does Windows warn me when I open it?

The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning for new apps. Click "More info" then "Run anyway".

What's the difference between the installer and the portable version?

The installer adds DN Launcher to your Start menu and handles updates. The portable version is a single .exe you can run from anywhere, no install needed.

Will it work with my existing mods?

Yes. You can drop in your own .jar files, import modpacks, or install everything from Modrinth and CurseForge inside the app.

Is there a Mac or Linux version?

Not yet. DN Launcher is Windows only for now.
